name: uav-resilience-bench
description:
UAV Navigation Resilience Benchmark
	


  
  
  
  



	
		
		Dataset Description
	

High-fidelity UAV navigation simulation data with realistic Electronic Warfare (EW) jamming scenarios based on OSINT profiles of Russian military systems deployed in Ukraine.

	
		
		Why This Dataset?
	

Most UAV navigation datasets are "fair weather" - they don't include adversarial conditions. This dataset fills that gap:

GPS Jamming: Realistic signal denial based on Zhitel, Pole-21, and Krasukha-4… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/chkmie/uav-resilience-bench.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / trajectory_error (RMSE) / detection/pose error depending on task
general_score_metric: task_success_rate (primary), with trajectory error (RMSE) for continuous metrics
reputation: Niche, domain-specific dataset hosted on Hugging Face that is gaining attention for UAV navigation resilience and EW robustness research.
